ReceiptPayload.title: ReceiptPayload
ReceiptPayload.description: The receipt payload of a supplier-delivery transition into partial/received: the W036 observation reference (the delivery-receipt observation), sorted received-quantity lines, and receipt provenance.

ObservationReference.title: ObservationReference
ObservationReference.description: One W036 Observation-distinction record reference: the kind-prefixed record id plus its exact content digest (the DeliveryRecord observation intake linkage).

ReceiptLine.title: ReceiptLine
ReceiptLine.description: One received-quantity line of a supplier-delivery receipt: description, quantity+unit (partial deliveries accumulate by exact decimal addition).

NonNegativeDecimal.title: NonNegativeDecimal
NonNegativeDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal amount as a canonical string (digest-safe, no exponent form).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).
